scope_note: Draft vocabulary for evidence-grounded classification of agricultural and environmental policies with explicit soil objectives or mechanisms.

relevance_levels.definition: Soil protection, restoration, monitoring or condition is an explicit policy objective.
The policy has another primary objective but explicitly specifies a soil-related mechanism, practice, indicator or expected soil effect.
The source explicitly identifies soil improvement as a secondary benefit.
A soil relationship may be agronomically plausible but is not stated in the supplied evidence.

soil_objectives.label: Soil erosion control
soil_objectives.definition: Prevent or reduce soil loss by water, wind or tillage.
soil_objectives.exclude: Generic land management without an explicit erosion pathway.

soil_objectives.label: Soil organic carbon
soil_objectives.definition: Maintain or increase soil organic carbon stocks or concentration.
soil_objectives.exclude: Generic GHG mitigation without an explicit soil-carbon mechanism.

soil_objectives.label: Soil organic matter
soil_objectives.definition: Maintain or improve soil organic matter or related soil condition.
soil_objectives.exclude: Carbon claims that do not address soil organic matter or carbon.

soil_objectives.label: Soil fertility and nutrient balance
soil_objectives.definition: Maintain fertility or improve nutrient balances and nutrient-use management.
soil_objectives.exclude: Input support without a stated soil or nutrient-management objective.

soil_objectives.label: Soil contamination control
soil_objectives.definition: Prevent, reduce, remediate or monitor contaminants in soil.
soil_objectives.exclude: Food-residue controls without a soil pathway.

soil_objectives.label: Soil biodiversity
soil_objectives.definition: Protect or restore soil organisms, biological activity or below-ground biodiversity.
soil_objectives.exclude: Above-ground biodiversity with no soil-biota connection.

soil_objectives.label: Soil structure and compaction
soil_objectives.definition: Improve aggregation, porosity or physical condition, or reduce compaction.
soil_objectives.exclude: Machinery support without an explicit soil-structure mechanism.

soil_objectives.label: Soil water retention
soil_objectives.definition: Improve infiltration, water-holding capacity or drought-buffering soil functions.
soil_objectives.exclude: Irrigation investment without an explicit soil-water function.

soil_objectives.label: Salinisation control
soil_objectives.definition: Prevent, monitor or remediate soil salinity or sodicity.
soil_objectives.exclude: Water-quality measures without a soil-salinity pathway.

soil_objectives.label: Land degradation and desertification
soil_objectives.definition: Prevent, reverse or monitor loss of land and soil productive or ecological capacity.
soil_objectives.exclude: Rural development without an explicit degradation pathway.

soil_objectives.label: Peatland and wetland soils
soil_objectives.definition: Protect, rewet or restore organic and wetland soils.
soil_objectives.exclude: Wetland biodiversity measures without an explicit soil or peat mechanism.

soil_objectives.label: Soil monitoring and information
soil_objectives.definition: Establish soil measurement, reporting, mapping or information systems.
soil_objectives.exclude: General farm reporting without soil variables.

policy_instruments.label: Regulatory requirement
policy_instruments.definition: A binding obligation, prohibition, threshold or management standard.

policy_instruments.label: Support conditionality
policy_instruments.definition: A soil-related condition attached to eligibility for public support.

policy_instruments.label: Area- or practice-based payment
policy_instruments.definition: Payment conditional on adopting or maintaining a defined soil-management practice.

policy_instruments.label: Result-based payment
policy_instruments.definition: Payment linked to a measured or verified environmental result.

policy_instruments.label: Investment support
policy_instruments.definition: Grant, loan, guarantee or other support for soil-related capital investment.

policy_instruments.label: Tax, fee or charge
policy_instruments.definition: A fiscal charge intended to influence soil-relevant behaviour or inputs.

policy_instruments.label: Advisory and training
policy_instruments.definition: Soil testing advice, extension, knowledge exchange, training or capacity building.

policy_instruments.label: Research and demonstration
policy_instruments.definition: Research, pilots, demonstrations or technology development related to soil.

policy_instruments.label: Monitoring and reporting
policy_instruments.definition: Mandatory or voluntary soil measurement, disclosure, mapping or reporting.

policy_instruments.label: Certification and labelling
policy_instruments.definition: A standard, certification or label containing soil-related criteria.

policy_instruments.label: Land-use planning
policy_instruments.definition: Spatial planning, zoning or land-allocation rules with explicit soil objectives.

policy_instruments.label: Voluntary agreement
policy_instruments.definition: A non-binding commitment or agreement adopted by public or private actors.
